items.title: Magazine: Made in the USA
items.summary: In this issue: Misumi Americas makes US manufacturing strategic priority, the celebrity brand ambassador rise in pharma, AI in the hospital pharmacy, and more.

items.title: Outlook Therapeutics wins FDA approval for Lytenava in wet AMD
items.summary: Outlook’s approval brings the first ophthalmic formulation of bevacizumab for the treatment of wet AMD.

items.title: Biointron introduces RushData platform for AI-driven antibody discovery
items.summary: Biointron Biological has launched RushData, a new platform to support the process of antibody discovery for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies employing AI and ML.

items.title: Kenvue’s Tylenol with Naproxen gains FDA approval
items.summary: The FDA has approved Kenvue’s Tylenol with Naproxen, the first OTC fixed-dose combination of acetaminophen and naproxen sodium.

items.title: Adult epilepsy market to reach $17.bn across 7MM by 2035
items.summary: The adult epilepsy market across the 7MM is poised to grow at a CAGR of 4.4% from $11.4bn in 2025 to $17.8bn in 2035.
